# `adt abap`

ABAP code execution commands

```bash
adt abap [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command        | Description                            |
| -------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `adt abap run` | Execute ABAP code from a file or stdin |

## `adt abap run`

Execute ABAP code from a file or stdin

```bash
adt abap run [options] [file]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description                        | Default |
| -------- | ---------------------------------- | ------- |
| `[file]` | Source file path (use - for stdin) | `-`     |

**Options**

| Option                 | Description                             | Default          |
| ---------------------- | --------------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| `--prefix <name>`      | Temp class name prefix                  | `zcl_adtcli_run` |
| `--package <pkg>`      | Package for the temp class              | `$TMP`           |
| `--transport <corrnr>` | Transport request (not needed for $TMP) |                  |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
